scope: Postprocess newly generated alphabet-only suffixes; start fresh at every suffix and after special taps. No inherited origin history.
invariants: Original suffix length, hold frames and special-tap positions unchanged path by path.
Original legal direction sets and button alphabet unchanged.
No selector, retention, observation, terminal or genesis change.
Defaults keep their identifiers and exact output bytes. Nondefault policy identity is explicit and mismatched replay is rejected.
emulator_allocation: None in this design record. Native cases require a separate prospective registration; no fresh search is authorized by a constructed task gain.
